meta.title: Pricing
meta.description: Free with no account, Pro for US$ 9.90 a month, Team for US$ 19.90 per person and Enterprise by contact.

title: Plans and pricing
body: Persisty's core is free and asks for no account. Paid plans unlock the request queue, account rotation and restore points; for teams, also control for whoever pays.

free.name: Free
free.tagline: To stay organised and lose nothing, with no account.

pro.name: Pro
pro.tagline: To leave the agent working without you.

team.name: Team
team.tagline: For teams that share AI accounts.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.tagline: For companies with security requirements and their own infrastructure.

features.recovery: Recovery after a freeze or a restart
features.usage: Spend per session and live 5 h and 7 d quota
features.networkLog: A log of every network call
features.accountRotation: Several Claude Code accounts with rotation
features.requestQueue: Request queue by quota or by time
features.restorePoints: A restore point for every request
features.worktrees: A folder of its own per session (git worktree)
features.offlineLicense: Licence valid 14 days offline, on 5 devices
features.finops: AI spend by project, model and account
features.sourceReview: Source code for audit, under NDA

items.a: No. Projects, persistent sessions, recovery, agent states, editor, git and AI usage stay free, with no account.
Most of what people who use agents already pay is in dollars, and this way the price is the same everywhere.

items.q: What happens if I stop paying for Pro?
items.a: Persisty goes back to the free plan. Nothing is lost: saved restore points can still be restored and requests already in the queue are still delivered.

items.q: Do I need internet to use Pro?
items.a: Not all the time. The licence is signed and valid for 14 days offline; the app renews it on its own when there is a connection.

items.q: On how many computers can I use it?

items.a: We agree with your company on what it needs: SSO, your own installation, a model gateway and access to the source code under NDA. These features are still planned.
